hero.title: A website that convinces from day one.
hero.description: No website yet, or ready for a fresh start? We take you from the first idea to a finished, professional site.

forWhom.title: For anyone who isn't visible online yet.
forWhom.description: Freelancers, small teams or a brand-new venture — the starting point is usually the same: good work with no website to show it.

items.title: Freelancers & experts
items.description: You do great work, but online you're hard to find — or you come across as less professional than you really are.

items.title: Small businesses
items.description: Your business runs well, but you've never had a proper website — or it never grew past a simple digital business card.

items.title: New ventures
items.description: You're launching something new and want a strong digital presence right from the start.

offerSection.title: What goes into building your site.
offerSection.description: A good website is more than just design. We handle every step that gets you there.

items.title: Concept & structure
items.description: We define which pages and content your website actually needs — and the order that builds trust.

items.title: Design & build
items.description: Your website takes shape with a clear layout, a premium feel, and a structure that works on every device.

items.title: Launch & handover
items.description: After the final polish, we launch together — you get a website that's ready to go from day one.

approachStatement.title: No templates. No half measures.
approachStatement.description: We don't build off-the-shelf websites. Every project starts with your business — not with a builder tool.

proofSection.title: What that looks like in practice.
proofSection.description: A premium real-estate website with a clear structure and professional property presentation — an example of a new digital presence building trust from day one.

faq.title: What you'd want to know beforehand.

items.question: What does it cost to have a website built?
items.answer: That depends on the scope of your project. You'll find a full overview of our packages and pricing on our prices page.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Usually a few weeks, depending on scope and how quickly we align on details. You can see the exact process on our process page.

items.question: Do I already need texts and images ready?
items.answer: No. It helps, but it isn't required — if something's missing, we help with structure and content.
